statement: For the standard Xbox One Microsoft USB IDs with zero mapping flags, pinned xpad configures eleven keys (face four, Menu/View, stick clicks, shoulder pair, Guide), four signed stick axes, two 10-bit triggers and two D-pad hat axes. It does not advertise KEY_RECORD on those entries; Share is a conditional mapping flag. The source's memoryless force-feedback path handles main rumble rather than independent trigger-motor control.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox One 0x02d1 / 0x02dd and One S 0x02ea xpad USB path, excluding special controllers
applicability.scope: xpad.c:420-469, 1095-1158, 1905-1925, 1973-2033 and xpad force-feedback consumer. Other devices and conditional build options can differ.
